notes.title: 10 years of My Free Farm 2 🎂 New feature in the farm game!
notes.content:
We would like to welcome a new [b]practical helper[/b] to the big farm anniversary: The Production Manager is ready to give you a fantastic overview in the future.

The new feature is called [b]Production Management[/b] and the name says it all: once you have hired the cool manager, he will organize all production processes on the 3D farm for you. With one click, you can pick up finished goods and start a new production right away.
Production management is particularly helpful for very large farms that have many production buildings.

Would you like to try it out for yourself? Then log in to My Free Farm 2 between May 6 and 13 at 12 noon and you can use the Production Manager [b]for free[/b] for three days. Don't miss this great opportunity!

[url=https://de.upjers.com/blog/40014/my-free-farm-2-das-upjers-farmspiel-feiert-jubilaeum][img]https://upportal.wavecdn.net/news//images/0507_2025_MFF2_birthday_640_250.jpg[/img][/url]

In our [url=https://de.upjers.com/blog/40014/my-free-farm-2-das-upjers-farmspiel-feiert-jubilaeum]blog[/url] for the tenth My Free Farm 2 anniversary, we also reveal what you can experience in May. There's a birthday calendar, a gift event and a [b]triple collection event[/b]!

You will also get to know the [b]anniversary merchant[/b] with his special offers. We've never revealed this much in advance before – Click through to our anniversary blog: [url=https://de.upjers.com/blog/40014/my-free-farm-2-das-upjers-farmspiel-feiert-jubilaeum]https://de.upjers.com/blog/40014/my-free-farm-2-das-upjers-farmspiel-feiert-jubilaeum[/url]

notes.title: Shivers, swag, shenanigans
notes.content:
[h1]Your quick peek at some the Halloween events in upjers games[/h1]

The night of Halloween is looming ahead. This means it‘s party-time for upjers!

We want to give you an overview on the [b]Halloween-Events[/b] starting across many games next 
week. Here‘s what you can expect:​

[h1]My Little Farmies[/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/789100/My_Little_Farmies/

From [b]October 22nd to 29th[/b] the Halloween-themed collector-event is waiting for you. Decorate your village with eeriely-cute Voodoo decorations to collect all the [b]Shrunken head[/b]-tokens to win valuable prizes like the new [b]„Saddler‘s“[/b] production facility. There you can craft saddles and other products.

[h1]My Free Zoo[/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/694130/My_Free_Zoo/

Is this too morbid for you? Then you may already be looking forward to collect [b]Lionhead tokens[/b] at My Free Zoo. Put up scary-looking glow-in-the-dark animal statues to have the chance to win the adorable and very exclusive [b]Siberian musk deer[/b] to exhibit in your zoo. ([i]The events runs 
between October 23rd and 30th.[/i])

[h1]My Free Farm[/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1049880/My_Free_Farm/

This year the My Free Farm Halloween-Event is challenging your gray matter again! The [b]Halloween card-matching game[/b] is back! When you mange to clear all cards from the table within ten tries, you have the chance to win new amusing trophies for your collection. ([i]October 22nd 
through to November 5th[/i].)

But also your  [b]Horse Farm[/b] (24 – 30 October), [b]Wauies[/b] (24 – 31 October), [b]My Sunny Resort[/b] (23 – 30 October) and [b]My Free Farm 2[/b] (29 October – 5 November) are packed full with fun events 
to take the edge off the dark season.

notes.title: Little Imps available now!
notes.content:
The quiet days are over! The sound of numerous imps working to expand the underground lair puts a smile on the face of even the most miserable rules of the deep. With its humorous fantasy elements, its online coop mode and unique battle features, dungeon tycoon game „Little Imps: A Dungeon Builder“ is the right game for any aspiring prince of darkness.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33026505/9b43b55f5a92a4f01249e20ff71909953a39fbaf.jpg[/img]

The Steam early access version of „Little Imps: A Dungeon Builder“ is now available.

notes.title: Want to swap Christmas cookies for a gingerbread man?
notes.content:
Until November 20th (10h CET), the weekly guild event is replaced by the Winter Event. All guild members should stock up on wheat, egg and beet sugar to prepare little Christmas-tree cookies.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32341234/f8b69de7b309325d13927b583383766f5602badf.jpg[/img]

Guild then pool their Christmas cookies. Reaching 12,500 cookies every guild member will receive a wooden Gingerbread Man. The best and most productive guilds can even get either the [b]golden, silver or bronze Gingerbread Man[/b].

So don‘t let your oven go cold and bake like you never baked before

Anyone not in a guild wanting to have something special might want to look at the newest [b]bonus gift[/b]: For every purchase of packs with 100+ Diamonds you may chose between the [b]Fountain with Fish[/b] or the [b]Pink Flamingo[/b].

notes.title: Trading Cards available!
notes.content:
[b]Trading Cards[/b] are now available in My Free Farm 2! Support the game and progressively unlock your cards with cute animals in lovely farm settings.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32341234/979a166678cc4f1e6e7f7b3d25a36d7df7384a91.jpg[/img]

You can collect five different cards and craft great [b]badges[/b] for your Steam Profile Page! For that, you'll get beautifully charming animal [b]emoticons[/b] and [b]profile backgrounds[/b].

Have a great time playing My Free Farm 2!

notes.title: May Dance
notes.content:
The bees are busy, and you can profit! From now until May 29 at 11:59 am CEST, you can produce wildflowers, honey and apple juice twice as fast!

Have fun playing!
